overview_description.description: Naran is a mobility fintech platform that provides rent-to-own vehicle financing, flexible payment terms, and fleet management software for gig economy drivers. The platform integrates directly with ride-hailing and delivery apps to automate payments and offer underbanked workers affordable access to cars and motorcycles.
